_README: Choice-point forecasting. The scored quantity is lift over the `obvious` arm, not accuracy. Read `tripwire` before anything else: if the blind arm beats chance the alternative sets leak and every number below is void.

caps.rule: earliest choices per person; cast by held-out count, both fixed before any forecast is made

tripwire.reading: THE ALTERNATIVE SETS LEAK by the pre-registered rule. The options alone predict the answer well above chance.

post_hoc.reading: blind does NOT beat the majority constant, so what it recovers is the class prior (one action dominates the menu and the record), not the phrasing. That is a degenerate label distribution, not outcome leakage -- a different problem, and not one a rerun of the same extraction fixes.
post_hoc.status: written after the rule fired; does not change the verdict

verdict: VOID by the pre-registered tripwire -- blind 0.622 > chance 0.311 + 0.10

mcnemar.caveat: ANTI-CONSERVATIVE. One `obvious` forecast is the reference for all of a person's hypotheses, so these pairs are not independent. Use permutation_p.

pooled.permutation_unit: choice point (all hypotheses on one point flip together)
